method: Read-only final source/protocol/documentation inspection and existing Linux guard receipt inspection. Reviewer ran no tests, services, Rust or DFS workloads.
resolved_blockers: Reader HELLO is followed by waiting for ACK0; coordinator emits ACK0 only after both unique HELLO events, preventing early READY before other HELLO.
Each reader waits for exact role/session/round/token ACK after DONE; coordinator records the end timestamp after both valid DONE before ACKn, preventing early next READY or FINAL.
Final fullSHA/EOF occurs after reader ACK5, and ACK5 is emitted only after common round5 end is recorded, keeping full-file verification outside the timed read phase.
Coordinator enforces Linux/aarch64/root and records monotonic clock implementation, properties and resolution.
Coordinator DONE requires PASS, actual rc0, and complete validated fixed C result instead of trusting a status string.
accepted_checks: Both reader roles B/C are required and unique at HELLO, READY for every measured round, DONE and FINAL.
Event type, reader role, session, expected round and DONE/ACK round token mismatch or duplication fail closed.
JsonLineReader uses select plus raw os.read against a monotonic deadline; incomplete JSON timeout, EOF and partial-line EOF fail instead of blocking in readline.
Manifest identity, full source/map, fixed C tool SHA, exact DFS mount and pre-content verification precede READY; one warmup round is excluded.
All START timestamps and end-after-both-DONE timestamps use the same coordinator process monotonic_ns; the coordinator never combines B/C clocks.
Every DONE contains a recorded C invocation returncode and validated 64MiB/1MiB/C1/close/content/operation-count result.
C subprocess nonzero, malformed result, short read and timeout produce FAIL; subprocess.run timeout branch kills and waits for its owned child.
Per-reader samples and round records are saved before DONE; coordinator records raw received events and completed round receipts on failure.
Fresh output directories are required and existing evidence is not overwritten by reader/writer exception handling.
Final EOF and full content verification must pass before reader FINAL(DATA_RECORDED); coordinator requires both successful FINAL events.

linux_guard_receipt.unaffected_reuse: Earlier R2 results retained and reused by parent; reviewer did not rerun them.
linux_guard_receipt.test_scope: Real coordinator stdio subprocess with synthetic event input and focused C process failure checks; does not constitute real DFS runtime acceptance.

timing_scope: START emit before B/C release through both valid DONE received and parsed. Includes host/Lima relay and scheduling, plus C launch and per-reader result/artifact write/emit overhead. ACK and final SHA/EOF are outside the measured window.
scope_limits: Deployment must run this coordinator on ctl Linux; its platform check alone does not identify the machine as ctl. Parent raw command/host identity provides that binding.
Parent owns the B/C/ctl relay lifecycle, exact remote process exit receipts and normal fixture cleanup; these helpers do not by themselves prove those exits.
Supplied ACK guard verifies an interactive coordinator ACK exchange, while final SHA gating placement is statically verified here; real readers/DFS measurement remains pending.
No actual DFS service/mount/writer/reader run is claimed by this tool review.
No G2.21 acceptance increment, three-sync durability,3FS comparison, cache qualification, unique physical64MiB corpus or broad standard-suite regression claimed.
